baseline.scope: One fixed reused key, fresh LLL, strict two-tour progressive schedule. The historical eight-tour run is excluded from this baseline and all its times. First successful beta is not globally minimal. Only method 1 of the intended four-method comparison has run.

baseline_budget_interpretation: historical_completed_baseline_without_time_limit; 473.11 is rounded observed runtime, not a prior timeout
first_success_beta_scope: First successful beta in the saved progressive schedule, not a global minimum.
memory_scope: Worker RUSAGE_SELF peak is the per-attempt measurement; a missing worker result leaves it unknown. command_peak_rss_kib is the capture process's cumulative RUSAGE_CHILDREN high-water mark. Group peak is the maximum known worker peak; peak_rss_complete reports coverage.

policy.baseline_budget_interpretation: Historical completed strict-two-tour baseline had no time cap; observed runtime is not a budget.
policy.bkz: Same baseline parameters; beta30 step1, two complete tours unless public-valid success or hard timeout, clean does not skip tour2; max min(256,256-k).
policy.budget_rule: Never increase caps; timeout=min(473.11, remaining)-2.1s reserves SIGTERM/SIGKILL cleanup. A residual <=2.1s is recorded as budget blocked.
policy.candidate_source: All reduced basis rows after LLL and every complete BKZ tour
policy.group_scheduling: Sequential single-thread workers across k, in listed order; no parallel solver contention.
policy.keygen: Reuse the saved n=128,q=97,(wf,wg)=(12,24) key, seed=1; uniform fixed-weight supports and independent signs; reject only noninvertible f; do not regenerate.
policy.online_stop: First public-valid candidate; independent evaluate after all online groups finish decides joint signed negacyclic equivalence, without feeding reference information into online search.
policy.pattern_enumeration: For index=0,1,... use SHA256('pattern-primal-v1:10001:'+str(index)) as Random seed, shuffle range(128), sorted first k positions. Skip duplicate sets.
policy.restart: User requested deletion of previous method2 results; all ten groups start at index0 with zero historical cost.
policy.tail_enumeration: T=[]; the sole hypothesis is the empty assignment
policy.timing_scope: Per-k sum of all subprocess wall times including startup, scans, checkpoints, failed/timeout cleanup plus online pattern/config/verification/launch overhead; excludes setup, tests, pauses, independent evaluate and the final provenance accounting commit itself.

stage_timing_scope: Completed reduction/scan measurements are separate from unfinished-stage observed intervals. Censored intervals include checkpoint and signal overhead; last-checkpoint intervals are lower bounds, with command-wall upper bounds including interpreter startup/cleanup. They must not be added as exact full reduction costs.
success_rule: Public-valid short pair and independent exact proof; same joint signed negacyclic shift of the original (f,g) is a correct recovery.
tail_and_decoder_scope: kappa=0: one empty tail hypothesis per pattern; target_count=0, slicer_calls=0; candidates are reduced basis rows.
timeout_interpretation: Censored observation, not evidence that the pattern guess was wrong.
timing_scope: All current-run worker wall time, timeout cleanup and public sampling/overhead; excludes prior pattern runs, key generation, tests, pauses, and offline audits.
